objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow (deploy, docs-site, tests) received a deliberate trigger decision, the schedule/issue workflows were correctly identified as out of scope, and the required check (tests.yml) got exactly the one shape that works — no workflow-level paths, salience computed in a step output that gates the real steps via `if:`, with no companion skip workflow.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each filter lists paths that workflow actually consumes — deploy ships src/runtime deps/deploy.sh, docs-site reads mkdocs.yml/docs, tests gates on src/test/package files — rather than catch-alls or copied sibling lists, though the sets are lightly inferred rather than verified against each workflow's every read.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only and issue-driven workflows and the branch-protection ruleset were left untouched, and only the three change-driven workflow files the audit called for were edited.
